title: ziziphora fominii
intro: Ziziphora fominii, commonly known as Russian tarragon, is a type of perennial herb native to Central Asia. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Ziziphora fominii include its ability to soothe digestive issues, relieve anxiety, and promote a restful sleep. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
